title: Spin and Quadrupole Sectors in Nonrelativistic Gravity
summary: We study the large-\(c\) expansion of general relativity in ADM variables. Using a unified even \(ω\)-expansion, the ADM formulation gives a common starting point for Galilean and Carrollian limits. We focus on the Galilean branch and derive the ADM action and field equations up to NNLO. We then construct stationary vacuum solutions of the Galilean ADM equations up to NNLO in weak and strong branches.
